drones.headline: Our Drones
drones.description: We deploy advanced drones to capture high-resolution aerial RGB / LiDAR imagery and multispectral data for Accurate Mapping, Monitoring, Planning, surveying, and engineering.

items.label: DJI Matrice 300 RTK
items.description: The DJI Matrice 300 RTK is a versatile and powerful drone designed for industrial applications, including surveying, mapping, and inspection. It features advanced flight capabilities, long battery life, and the ability to carry various payloads, making it ideal for professional use in challenging environments.

items.label: DJI Air 3S
items.description: The DJI Air 3S is a compact and portable drone that offers high-quality aerial photography and videography capabilities. It features a dual-camera system, long flight time, and intelligent flight modes, making it suitable for both professional and recreational use.

items.label: DJI Mavic 3M / 3E
items.description: The DJI Mavic 3M / 3E is a lightweight and portable drone that provides excellent aerial imaging capabilities. It features a high-resolution camera, obstacle avoidance sensors, and intelligent flight modes, making it ideal for capturing stunning photos and videos from the sky.

items.label: DJI Mavic 3 Pro
items.description: The DJI Mavic 3 Pro is a versatile choice for site documentation and reconnaissance mapping, pairing a triple-camera Hasselblad system with orthomosaic-capable photogrammetry for high-detail visual capture.

items.label: DJI Phantom 4
items.description: The DJI Phantom 4 remains a proven, reliable choice for cadastral and engineering mapping, pairing a mechanical shutter camera with dependable GNSS and vision-based positioning for accurate mapping.

items.label: Land Surveying
items.description: We provide a wide range of land surveying services, including topographical surveys, boundary surveys, sectional properties, building site surveys, resource mapping, bathymetric surveys, hydrographic surveys, and GIS mapping. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.

deliverables.label: Deliverables
deliverables.description: Every project is delivered with professional, ready-to-use outputs tailored to the project needs:

items.label: Aerial Surveys
items.description: We offer a wide range of aerial surveying services, including drone imagery surveys, Lidar mapping, agricultural NDVI mapping, as-built surveys, monitoring and evaluation, solar panel drone surveys, volumetric surveys, and landfill & quarry drone surveys. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.

deliverables.description: Every project is delivered with professional, ready-to-use outputs tailored to the project needs:

items.label: Civil Engineering
items.description: We offer a wide range of civil engineering services, including site engineering, building setting out, underground utilities installation, highway engineering, stake out, leveling, benchmarking, and construction services. Our deliverables include as-built maps, digital elevation models, setting out coordinates, 3D data, contours, master plans, building layouts, CAD shapefiles, and PDF maps.
